thread:
marco: Heads up — linkcheck in the migration branch is spitting 404s for several anchors in the preview build. Docusaurus preview shows anchors that used to exist but now go to 404. anyone on this?
rachel: I noticed a pattern: headings that had explicit IDs removed during the frontmatter cleanup lost their anchors, and some example snippets reference the old anchors.
sam: can you paste one of the failing links?
marco: sure — example: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/docs/guides/deploy#quickstart-aws -> preview shows 404 for `#quickstart-aws`. The heading in the new file is `## Quick start (AWS)` without an explicit id, so slugger produced `quick-start-aws` instead of `quickstart-aws`.
devx: this is the classic slug mismatch. I pushed a tiny patch to the migration branch that normalizes to the legacy slugger for compatibility. Try running `yarn docs:build --linkcheck` locally with that branch.
marco: pasted the local failing snippet so folks can repro:
```
# Quickstart AWS

Some text...

## Quick start (AWS)

Example usage below
```
marco: the old anchor was `#quickstart-aws` (no hyphen between quick and start), new slugger yields `#quick-start-aws`.
liang: we're also seeing MkDocs linkcheck complain about soft-hyphen/ZWNBSP in a couple internationalized headings — those end up as funky slugs too. I can add a pre-slug cleaning step that drops ZWNJ/soft-hyphen characters.
rachel: I can do two things: 1) add redirects for the most-used anchors in Docusaurus `redirects.js`, and 2) update the code samples that reference the old anchors to use the normalized slugs (or add explicit heading IDs). Which do you prefer?
sam: do both if it's small — redirects are safer short-term, but backfilling snippets prevents future link rot.
marco: agree. small PR plan: devx lands slug-compat toggle + zwnj cleanup, rachel lands redirect entries for top 10 anchors and updates 3 example snippets, liang adds the slug cleaning util and unit tests. I'll coordinate to land in order.
deploy-bot: deploy preview created: https://deploy-preview-402.docs.redwood.ai — linkcheck run queued.
rachel: also adding a tiny CI test: a markdown snippet in `docs/tests/anchor-regressions.md` with the legacy anchors so linkcheck flags regressions earlier.
sam: LGTM. @rachel can you include the test and a short comment in the PR explaining why we need legacy slugs? :thumbsup:
rachel: yep — will include the reasoning and examples. aiming to open PRs today, will ping this thread when ready.
marco: thanks — once the CI linkcheck passes on the preview we can cut the patch for the migration branch and unblock the docs migration.
liang: I'll open a tiny PR for the slug sanitizer and tests in ~30m.
rachel: opened docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/212 — includes redirects and two snippet fixes.
marco: saw the PR, adding a quick review now. small nit: please include the `<!-- id: quickstart-aws -->` explicit id on the heading rather than relying entirely on redirects for the AWS page (makes the history clearer).
rachel: good call, adding the explicit id.
sam: once tests pass I'll merge. thanks everyone!
